items.reason: Same partner, wording only: the expansion phase gives quisinostat 'concurrently with their standard of care (SOC) fractionated RT'. Use the generic label 'radiotherapy'.

Two registered EXPERIMENTAL arms ('Recurrent WHO Grade 4 Glioblastoma IDH-WT', 'Newly-Diagnosed WHO Grade 4 Glioblastoma IDH-WT'), neither a control; manual R8 gives 'no' for more than one arm without a control and 'not_applicable' only for single-arm trials.

note: EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/1b): translational subset only (D23). IDH-wildtype only defines GBM, so it is not a molecular selection. Entry to the expansion depends on a tumour 'PK response' (drug concentration), which is not a molecular biomarker.
